title: Why Your Brain Loves Small Wins

scenes.text: Did you know your brain gives you a tiny reward for every *small* win?
It is true, and it is the secret behind every *habit* that sticks.
When you finish something easy, your brain feels *proud* and wants more.
That is why a huge goal feels scary, but a tiny step feels *safe*.
So stop waiting for motivation, because motivation is *unreliable* on tired days.
Instead, make the first step so small that it is almost *funny*.
Read one page, do one pushup, or write one single *sentence*.
Then watch how fast your *energy* starts to rise!
Tomorrow, repeat it, and soon those small wins become a *big* life change.

title: 3 Reasons You Feel Tired All Day

scenes.text: Do you wake up tired even after a *full* night of sleep?
The problem may not be how *long* you sleep, but how well.
Reason one: your phone *light* keeps your brain awake at night.
Put it away one hour before bed, and your sleep gets *deeper*.
Reason two: you skip *sunlight* in the morning.
Ten minutes of morning light tells your body that the *day* has started.
Reason three: too much *caffeine* late in the afternoon.
Try stopping coffee after noon and see how you *feel*.
Fix these three things, and your *energy* will thank you!

title: The Two Minute Rule That Beats Laziness

scenes.text: Here is a *simple* trick that beats laziness every single time.
It is called the *two minute* rule.
Whatever you want to do, just do it for only *two* minutes.
Want to study? Open the book for two *minutes*.
Want to exercise? Put on your shoes and move for two *minutes*.
The hardest part is always the *start*, never the work itself.
Once you begin, your brain usually says, why not *continue*?
And if you stop after two minutes, that is still a *win*.
Try it today, and *share* it with a friend who needs it!
